Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from Dubai, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.
On today's show, stocks rebounded as investors returned to the AI trade. Nasdaq futures point to a higher open when markets return from the Thanksgiving holiday on Friday. The tech-heavy gauge briefly reached the threshold for a bear market on Wednesday, falling 20% from its October peak.
